local fguiUtils = {}
local bindedUrls = {}

---@overload fun(filename:string): UIGComponent
loadFGUIScript = loadFGUIScript or require

---fgui Class bridge
---@generic T: FairyGUI.GObject, K
---@param name string
---@param base T
---@return K: T
function fguiUtils.Class(name, base)
    local cls = class(name)
    setmetatable(cls, { __index = base })
    cls.base = base

    function cls:Bridge(ins)
        local t = {}
        setmetatable(t, self)
        tolua.setpeer(ins, t)
        t.class = self
        return t
    end

    function cls:Bind(url)
        if bindedUrls[url] == self then return end
        bindedUrls[url] = self
        FairyGUI.UIObjectFactory.SetExtension(url, typeof(self.base), function (ins) return self:Bridge(ins) end)
    end
    
    function cls:Unbind(url)
        bindedUrls[url] = nil
        FairyGUI.UIObjectFactory.ClearExtension(url)
    end
    
    return cls
end

---@class IComponent: UIGComponent
---@field public URL string static 
---@field public NAME string static 
---@field public PACKAGES string[] static 
---@field public ctor function
---@field public InitMembers function
---fgui Component extend
---@generic T, K: IComponent
---@param name string
---@param base T
---@return K
function fguiUtils.Component(name, base)
    local cls = fguiUtils.Class(name, base)
    
    function cls:BindSelf()
        self:Bind(self.URL)
    end
    
    function cls:UnbindSelf()
        self:Unbind(self.URL)
    end

    --- object function
    function cls:ctor()
        self:InitMembers()
    end

    ---@overload
    function cls:InitMembers()
    end

    function cls:dtor()
        tolua.setpeer(self, nil)
    end
    
    return cls
end


---Bind
---@generic T: FairyGUI.GObject
---@param url string
---@param cls T
function fguiUtils.Bind(url, cls)
    cls:Bind(url)
end

return fguiUtils
